args.title: Clear previous upload error when picking a new file
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Clear any previous upload error (`setProblem(null)`) when a new file is chosen in `UploadForm`.

label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`UploadForm` does not clear the `problem` state when selecting a new file, so previous upload error messages persist until a new upload is attempted. Clearing `setProblem(null)` in the file input's `onChange` handler fixes this.
